entity_id.description: You can get entity id from your integration, for example, from a url of a HubSpot deal.

operations.name: List forms
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of forms with optional filtering and sorting options.

count.description: Specify how many forms to return. Default is 50 forms, maximum is 100 forms.

page.description: Specify which page of the dataset to return.

status.description: Specify which status of the forms dataset to return.

order_by.description: Specify the form dataset order to return.

asc.description: Specify sorting the result-set in ascending or descending order.

operations.name: List linked objects
operations.description: Get a list of linked objects for the document.

operations.name: List api log
operations.description: Get the list of all logs within the selected workspace.\ Optionally filter by date, page, and `#` of items per page.

since.description: Determines a point in time from which logs should be fetched. Either a specific ISO 8601 datetime or a relative identifier such as "-90d" (for past 90 days).

to.description: Determines a point in time from which logs should be fetched. Either a specific ISO 8601 datetime or a relative identifier such as "-10d" (for past 10 days) or a special "now" value.

count.description: The amount of items on each page. The total number of accessible items (`count × page`) must not exceed 10,000.

page.description: Returns page of the results by number. The total number of accessible items (`count × page`) must not exceed 10,000.

statuses.description: Returns only the predefined status codes.

methods.description: Returns only the predefined HTTP methods. Allows GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE.

search.description: Returns the results containing a string.

operations.name: List members
operations.description: Retrieve all members details of the workspace implied by the OAuth token or API key.\ For each member, the `workspace` parameter shows their active workspace, that is the workspace they are currently working in.\ This means the `workspace` value can differ from the workspace implied by your API key.

operations.name: List notaries
operations.description: Retrieve a list of notaries associated with your organization. ## Important Notes - At the moment, notaries can be added to organization only manually through the PandaDoc Notary UI. - Organization must have Notary addon enabled to use this endpoint

status.description: Filter by status (comma-separated values supported). Valid values are INVITED, UNDER_REVIEW, ACTIVE, REJECTED, INACTIVE

commission_state.description: Filter by commission state (comma-separated values supported)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

order_by.description: Sort by name, email, or status (default is email). Use a - prefix for descending order (e.g., -email)

operations.name: List notarization requests
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of notarization requests for your organization. Results can be filtered by status, creator, or document, and sorted by status or by the request's creation or completion dates. ## Permissions > 🔒 **Requirements** > > - The **Notary On-Demand** or **Notary** add-on must be enabled for your organization. Without an active add-on, the endpoint returns `403 Forbidden`. > - The

created_by_user_id.description: Filter by creator user ID (comma-separated values supported).

document_id.description: Filter by document ID (comma-separated values supported).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

order_by.description: Sort field. Use a `-` prefix for descending order (e.g., `-date_created`). When omitted, results are sorted by `date_created` ascending (oldest first).

operations.name: Recent sms opt out
operations.description: Retrieves a list of the most recent SMS opt-out changes for each phone numbers used in your workspace. > 📘 You can filter results by time range using `timestamp_from` and `timestamp_to`.

timestamp_from.description: The start of the timestamp. If no timestamp is provided, 1 hour before the current time will be used.

timestamp_to.description: The end of the timestamp range. If no timestamp is provided the current time will be used.

operations.name: List document sections
operations.description: Retrieve information about the sections within a document.

operations.name: List templates folders
operations.description: Get the list of folders that contain Templates in your account. > 📘 > > The root folder is not listed in the response. For the full list of folder operations and their limitations, see [Organize Templates and Folders](https://developers.pandadoc.com/docs/organize-folders).

parent_uuid.description: The UUID of the folder containing folders. To list the folders located in the root folder, remove this parameter in the request.

count.description: Optionally, specify how many folders to return.

page.description: Optionally, specify which page of the dataset to return.

operations.name: List templates
operations.description: Retrieves a list of templates. You can filter results by a search query, tags, or fields.

q.description: Search query. Filter by template name.

count.description: Specify how many templates to return.

page.description: Specify which page of the dataset to return.

folder_uuid.description: UUID of the folder where the templates are stored.

tag.description: Search tag. Filter by template tag.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response.

operations.name: List users
operations.description: Get a list of all users with membership in your organization, with their contact information, license type, and workspace roles. You must be an organization admin to list users.

show_removed.description: Filter option - show users with removed memberships.

operations.name: List webhook events
operations.description: This operation retrieves a paginated list of all webhook events.

count.description: Specify how many event results to return.

page.description: Specify which page of the dataset to return.

since.description: Return results where the event creation time is greater than or equal to this value.

to.description: Return results where the event creation time is less than this value.

type.description: Returns results by the specified event types.

http_status_code.description: Returns results with the specified HTTP status codes.

error.description: Returns results with the following errors.

operations.name: List webhook subscriptions
operations.description: This operation fetches a paginated list of webhook subscriptions.

operations.name: Notarization request details
operations.description: Get details about a notarization request by its `id`. Details include: - Basic notarization request information (status, creator, invitees). - Signed documents information with links for downloading. - Notarization session recording information with link for downloading. - Timestamps associated with a notarization request. - Termination reason and details when the notarization session was not comp

operations.name: Quote update
operations.description: This operation updates the details of a specific quote within a document by specifying the document ID and quote ID.

summary.description: Summary settings containing adjustments (discounts, fees, taxes) and custom columns that apply to the entire quote / section total.

sections.description: Quote sections - this property overrides existing sections in the specified order. If you want to change only one section, you must still pass other sections IDs. Otherwise these sections will be removed.

settings.description: Quote settings. Denotes whether a quote is optional or selected, and selection type inside the section - single, multiple, or custom.

operations.name: Change signer (reassign document recipient)
operations.description: Reassign fields to another signer. > 🚧 Before you start > > To change a signer in a document, please ensure that: > > - You have the 'Can Manage Recipients' permission. > - New signer is already created in your contacts. If not, add them using the [Create Contact](https://developers.pandadoc.com/reference/create-contact) endpoint. You can reassign fields to another signer before the original signe

operations.name: Remove member from workspace
operations.description: This operation removes a specified member from a workspace by providing the workspace ID and member ID.

operations.name: Rename documents folder
operations.description: Rename Documents Folder. For the full list of folder operations and their limitations, see [Organize Documents and Folders](https://developers.pandadoc.com/docs/organize-folders).

id.description: The UUID of the folder that you are renaming.

name.description: Provide a new name for the folder.

operations.name: Rename templates folder
operations.description: Rename a templates folder. For the full list of folder operations and their limitations, see [Organize Templates and Folders](https://developers.pandadoc.com/docs/organize-folders).

id.description: The UUID of the folder which you are renaming.

name.description: Provide a new name for the folder.

operations.name: List catalog items search
operations.description: This method searches for items in your [product catalog](https://support.pandadoc.com/en/articles/9714691-product-catalog). Use the `query` parameter to search in title, SKU, description, category name, custom fields name and value. You can also search for items by their type, billing type, and category id. Order search results, in both ascending and descending order, by these item properties: - S

query.description: Search query. Searches the following fields: Title, SKU, description, category name, custom fields name and value.

order_by.description: Ordering principle for displaying search results.

exclude_uuids.description: A list of item uuids to be excluded from search.

operations.name: [beta] list documents search
operations.description: Find documents from a natural-language query. PandaDoc AI interprets the query and returns the matching documents. PandaDoc offers two document search tools: this AI-powered search and the structured List Documents endpoint. Document Search Tools Guide — click to expand #### When to use AI Search (this endpoint) - The query is in natural language (e.g., "show me all completed documents from Q2 202

q.description: Natural-language search query. Supports filtering by status, owner, dates, and folder. Also supports keyword content search across document titles and body text.

operations.name: Document section upload status
operations.description: Receive the upload status of the document and sections by their `upload_id`. Requesting document section upload status is useful to ensure a document section upload is in the expected state before calling additional API methods. In response, you receive an array with `sections_uuid`. You can receive information about each section using the [Document Section Info](https://developers.pandadoc.com/re

operations.name: Document section details
operations.description: Receive information about each section.

operations.name: Send document
operations.description: > 🚧 Using the Sandbox Key > > When you use a [sandbox API key](https://developers.pandadoc.com/reference/sandbox-key) during the free trial period, the sender and recipient email addresses must be from the same organisation (email domain). ## Document State - You can only send a document in the `document.draft` status. - After creating a new document, it usually retains a `document.uploaded` statu

message.description: A message that will be sent by email with a link to a document to sign.

subject.description: Value that will be used as the email subject.

silent.description: If set to `true`, disables email notifications for document recipients and the document sender. Also disables scheduled reminders (manual reminders still possible). Doesn't affect "Approve document" email notification sent to the Approver.

sender.description: You can set a sender of a document as an `email` or `membership_id`

forwarding_settings.description: Set settings for Document and Signature forwarding.

reply_to.description: Email address that will be used as a reply-to address for the document. To use this parameter, please contact the support team to have it enabled for your account.

operations.name: Content library item status
operations.description: Requesting the CLI status helps verify that a CLI is in the expected state before invoking additional API methods. ## Available CLI Statuses The following is a complete list of all possible CLI statuses returned: | CLI Status | Status Description | |-----------------|--------------------| | `cli.UPLOADED` | The CLI upload process has been initiated and is currently in progress. It will soon transi

operations.name: Document status
operations.description: It is useful to request document status to ensure a document is in the expected state before calling additional API methods. ### Required Document Statuses Here are some common methods and the `document.status` required to proceed: | API Method | Required Document State | | :------------------- | :---------------------- | | Send A Document | `document.draft` | | Get Document Details | `document.dr

operations.name: Document auto reminder status
operations.description: Retrieves the current auto reminder status per recipient for a specified document. Recipients who could not receive reminders due to validations (recipient groups, non-signers, etc.) will be skipped and not included in the response.

operations.name: Template status
operations.description: ## Available Template Statuses The following is a complete list of all possible template statuses returned: | Template Status | Status Description | | :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `template.UPLOADED` | The template upload process has been initiated and is currently

operations.name: Get template settings
operations.description: Retrieves the settings for a specified template. Only the language field is currently supported.

template_id.description: Unique identifier of the template to retrieve settings for.

operations.name: Update template settings
operations.description: Updates the settings for a specified template. Only the language field is currently supported.

template_id.description: Unique identifier of the template to update settings for.

operations.name: Transfer all documents ownership
operations.description: This method transfers ownership of all documents from one member to another.

from_membership_id.description: A unique identifier of a workspace member from whom you want to transfer ownership.

to_membership_id.description: A unique identifier of a workspace member to whom you want to transfer ownership.

operations.name: Update document ownership
operations.description: This operation allows transferring the ownership of a document to another user by specifying the document ID and membership ID.

membership_id.description: A unique identifier of a workspace member.

operations.name: Update catalog item
operations.description: Update catalog item.

operations.name: Update contact
operations.description: This method updates a contact details.

operations.name: Update document
operations.description: Use the PATCH method to update a PandaDoc document. > 🚧 Document status > > You can only update a document in the Draft status (`document.draft`). > > After creating a new document, it usually retains a `document.uploaded` status for 3-5 seconds while the document syncs across PandaDoc servers. When the document is available for further API calls, the document moves to the `document.draft` state.

recipients.description: The list of recipients you're sending the document to. The ID or email are required. If the ID is passed, an existing recipient will be updated. If the email is passed, a new recipient will be added to CC.

fields.description: Set specific values to the fields. This object maps merge field names to their corresponding values. Each key represents a merge field name, and each value is an object containing the data to populate that field with. The structure allows you to pre-populate various field types including text inputs, checkboxes, dropdowns, and date fields. **Key Points:** - Keys must match the exact merge field na

tokens.description: Create or initialize multiple variables with their values using tokens/values list.

tags.description: Mark your document with one or several tags.

metadata.description: You can pass arbitrary data in the key-value format to associate custom information with a document. This information is returned in any API requests for the document details by id. If metadata exists in a document then the value will be updated. Otherwise, metadata will be added to the document.

images.description: You can pass a list of images to image blocks (one image in one block) for replacement.

texts.description: You can pass a list of texts to text blocks for replacement.

operations.name: Update document auto reminder settings
operations.description: Configures automatic reminders for document recipients. These reminders are sent after the document's initial dispatch. Settings include enabling reminders, delivery method (email/SMS), initial delay, and recurrence frequency.

enabled.description: Toggles auto-reminders for the document. If `true`, reminders are scheduled based on the configuration.

delivery_method.description: The method used to deliver reminders (e.g., email, SMS).

initial_delay_days.description: Number of days to wait after sending the document before the first reminder is sent.

is_recurring.description: If `true`, reminders will be sent repeatedly at specified intervals after the initial reminder.

recurrence_frequency_days.description: Number of days between recurring reminders, applicable if `is_recurring` is `true`.

operations.name: Update document fields assignment
operations.description: Assign, reassign, or unassign document fields to recipients. Supports bulk operations by accepting multiple field assignment items in a single request. > 🚧 Before you start > > - The document must be in the 'Draft' (`document.draft`) status. > - You must have the 'Can Edit Document' permission.

fields.description: An array of field assignment operations. Each item specifies a field and the recipient it should be assigned to.

operations.name: Template update
operations.description: Update a template. Currently supports updating template variables (`tokens`) and managing template roles. > 🚧 Template status > > You can only update a template in the PROCESSED status (`template.PROCESSED`). > > After creating a new template, it usually retains a `template.uploaded` status for 3-5 seconds while the template syncs across PandaDoc servers. When the template is available for further

tokens.description: Create or initialize multiple CUSTOM variables with their values using tokens/values list. Template's predefined variables are read-only. Any attempts to do so will be ignored.

roles.description: Replace the full set of template roles. Items with an existing `id` are updated, items without an `id` are created as new roles, and existing roles whose `id` is not present in the list are deleted.

operations.name: Update template sharing settings
operations.description: Replaces the full list of Workspaces this Template is shared with. The caller must be a member of every Workspace being newly shared by this call. Unsharing a Workspace only requires permission to edit the Template.

template_id.description: Unique identifier of the Template whose Shares are being replaced.

workspace_ids.description: Unique identifiers of the Workspaces the Template should be shared with, representing the complete desired end-state rather than a delta. Duplicate ids are deduplicated, and the server replaces the prior shares with this set atomically.

operations.name: Update webhook subscription
operations.description: This operation updates the details of a webhook subscription.

name.description: Set a new name for the Webhooks subscription.

url.description: Set the new Webhooks subscription URL.

active.description: Set the status of the Webhooks subscription.

triggers.description: Set trigger events for the Webhooks subscription.

operations.name: Update webhook subscription shared key
operations.description: This operation regenerates the shared key for a specific webhook subscription identified by its UUID.

operations.name: [beta] update workspace
operations.description: Update a workspace's name and branding. - You need to be an Org Admin to update a workspace.

name.description: A new name for the workspace.

icon_url.description: Workspace icon displayed in the application; not visible to your customers. Icon should have square proportions. The URL must be publicly reachable over HTTPS. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP. Max size: 5 MB.

branding.description: Customer-facing branding shown to recipients on the document signing page and in branded emails and templates.

operations.name: Create document section
operations.description: With this endpoint, you can add a new section to an existing PandaDoc document (create a bundle). You can upload a section to the document using a PandaDoc template or a file by URL. > ⏱️ Document Section creation is a non-blocking (asynchronous) operation > > The document creation process may take some time. > > With a successful request, you receive a response with the created upload ID and stat

merge_field_scope.description: Determines how the fields are mapped when creating a section. * document: Default value. The fields of the entire document are updated. * upload: Only the fields from the created section are updated. The merge field is appended with the upload ID.

operations.name: Create document section from file upload
operations.description: With this endpoint, you can add a new section to an existing PandaDoc document (create a bundle). The section is created from a file you upload. The file can be a PDF, DocX, or RTF. > 📘 We've prepared two samples that you can use to test the request. > Download them here: > > - [Download a Sample PDF with Form Fields](https://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/2127247/public-templates/SamplePandaDocPdf_FormFi

merge_field_scope.description: Determines how the fields are mapped when creating a section. * document: Default value. The fields of the entire document are updated. * upload: Only the fields from the created section are updated. The merge field is appended with the upload ID.
